note: Official TEST splits only. No intensity/score labels exist on these datasets, so score questions are omitted rather than proxied.

meld.name: MELD (text annotations)
meld.domain: Multi-party scripted TV dialogue from Friends
meld.licence: Repository is GPL-3.0. The transcripts are from the copyrighted TV series Friends; used here for research/evaluation only, text annotations only (no audio or video).
meld.choice_mapping: Gold is the official Emotion field, lowercased. Labels are not renamed (MELD uses joy, not happiness).

noul_mapping.emotion: Yes iff the official Emotion equals the named option.
noul_mapping.frustrated: Derived: yes iff Emotion is anger or disgust.
noul_mapping.support: Derived: yes iff Emotion is sadness or fear.

ew.name: EmoWOZ
ew.split: official test (1,000 MultiWOZ + 100 DialMAGE dialogues; 8,634 labelled user turns)
ew.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial, attribution required). Authors also say research use only.
ew.choice_mapping: Gold is the official majority-vote emotion integer mapped to the paper's tokens: 0 neutral, 1 fearful (also sad/disappointed), 2 dissatisfied (also disliking), 3 apologetic, 4 abusive, 5 excited (also happy/anticipating), 6 satisfied (also liking). Options are these tokens, not remapped onto Ekman.

noul_mapping.emotion: Yes iff the official token equals the named option.
noul_mapping.frustrated: Derived: yes iff the token is dissatisfied or abusive (negative emotion elicited by the system, polite or impolite).
noul_mapping.support: Derived: yes iff the token is fearful (sad/disappointed/fearful elicited by events outside the system's control). Dissatisfied is not treated as needing support.
noul_mapping.positive: Yes iff the token is satisfied or excited.
noul_mapping.neutral: Yes iff the token is neutral.

carer.name: CARER / dair-ai/emotion
carer.domain: Single-turn English Twitter messages (not multi-turn chat)
carer.split: official test split of the 'split' config (2,000 tweets)
carer.licence: Educational and research purposes only (dataset card / GitHub).
carer.choice_mapping: Gold is the official six-way label: sadness, joy, love, anger, fear, surprise. There is no neutral class.

noul_mapping.emotion: Yes iff the official label equals the named option.
noul_mapping.frustrated: Derived: yes iff the label is anger.
noul_mapping.support: Derived: yes iff the label is sadness or fear.
noul_mapping.positive: Yes iff the label is joy or love.

score: Skipped. None of MELD, EmoWOZ or CARER has an official emotion-intensity score. No proxy was invented.
